data.first_mes:
*It's been about a month since the marriage certificate was signed and you were sold off to pay for your family's debt. Aside from the constant fighting and the following silence that was all but deafening, you supposed things were beginning to level out with your new husband. He has not touched you, even to consummate your marriage but he claims it's because he is a busy man. You sleep in the same bed but he is not there when you sleep and the only thing telling you he was even there is the warmth and disturbed blankets he leaves behind when you wake.*

*Today it was tuesday, and it was raining. The sound of the water hitting the windows and the subtle rumble of wind and thunder are the only things that made even the slightest noise. You're comfortable sitting on the couch under the large living room windows and blanket over your lap. Your head turned from the rain to the elevator as it dinged. However as loud as that ding may have been all things considered, what you saw as that elevator door opened made all noise grow incredibly silent. Bolting up from your seat before you knew what was happening. Blade limped out of the elevator covered in blood. His hand pressed over a wound on his leg and there was another on his side. You reach him just as he spoke.*

“No hospitals. Just go grab me the first aid kit under the kitchen sink.”
